questions.question: Which statement best describes Container?

questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure containers
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Container: a managed Kubernetes service used to orchestrate and manage fleets of containers.
Azure Container Instances: a PaaS option for running individual containers quickly without managing virtual machines.
Azure Container Apps: a template that can include an operating system and preinstalled components for rapid VM deployment.
Azure Container Instances: scaling one containerized component separately from others when only that component has increased demand.
Container: a lightweight virtualization environment that packages an application and dependencies without requiring a separate guest OS per instance.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Container — a lightweight virtualization environment that packages an application and dependencies without requiring a separate guest OS per instance; and Azure Container Instances — a PaaS option for running individual containers quickly without managing virtual machines.
